name: get_products_by_gtins
description: Retrieves product details for a list of GTINs (barcodes/EANs) from Carrefour France, optionally scoped to a specific facility/store service. Returns product details including EAN, title, brand, category, images, business type, and links for each matching product. Useful for bulk product lookups by barcode.

gtins.description: List of GTINs (EAN/barcode strings) identifying the products to retrieve.

facilityServiceId.description: The facility/store service ID to scope product availability and offers (e.g. '0678-150-7052').
